title: Taiwan civilian rail station reference and historical flow observations

coverage.description: Official Taiwan Railways directory points plus calendar year 2021 station passenger and line level freight observations.

temporal_contract.station_directory_reason: The official endpoint is mutable and the retained snapshot was retrieved after the bookmark without a proved prebookmark archive.
temporal_contract.flow_observations_reason: The historical 2021 dataset was cataloged before the bookmark and describes a completed calendar year.

exclusions.reason: The official directory record contains no GPS value, so no coordinate was invented.
The 2021 flow file contains a zero passenger row without a matching station directory record. It is not promoted to a station node.

known_gaps: Independent infrastructure review has not passed.
The postbookmark station directory snapshot cannot initialize the 1 September 2025 opening state.
Directory points do not prove passenger service, freight service, current operability, engineering capacity, train frequency, rolling stock, crew, power, signaling, repair, storage, or substitution.
The 2021 activity observations are historical and must not be treated as 2025 utilization or capacity.
Station level freight is withheld by the source; line totals cannot be allocated to individual stations.
Rail line geometry, topology, track count, electrification, signaling, bridges, tunnels, gradients, transfer links, and disruption state are not populated.
Military ownership, tenancy, access, use, defenses, target status, and damage susceptibility have not been assessed.
notes: This packet supports map reference, civilian mobility, evacuation, economic access, and later logistics abstraction. It creates no executable route, capacity, mission, or military access by itself.
